add_definitions(-D__WINESRC__)
include_directories(BEFORE ${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/sdk/include/wine)
spec2def(mapi32.dll mapi32.spec)

# mapi32.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/mapi32-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(mapi32_shims OBJECT imalloc.c mapi32_main.c prop.c sendmail.c stubs.c util.c guid.c)
target_link_libraries(mapi32_shims PRIVATE uuid wine libshlwapi libuser32 libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libkernel32_vista libntdll)
add_cargo_module(mapi32 mapi32-cargo mapi32.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS mapi32_shims psdk uuid_sources)
